mechanism: 저품질 제품 가격의 변화가 수요·가격·제품 선택 경로를 통해 제품·사업별 판매 규모의 감소로 이어질 수 있다는 조건부 설명 초안이다.
conditions: 논문의 처치·결과 정의와 대상 기업의 변수 정의가 일치할 것
논문의 모집단·시기·제도 및 효과 발생 시차가 적용 대상과 부합할 것

원자료 R01564의 적용 맥락: This paper studies online retail markets mediated by the Pricewatch price-search engine, using hourly Pricewatch listings and transaction-level sales and wholesale cost data from a single multi-site retailer for eight product categories (memory modules and AMD Athlon CPUs) between May 2000 and May 2001 (CPUs May–Nov 2000). Units include website-day observations and individual transactions within a US-based computer-parts market characterized by many small e-retailers, rank-ordered price lists, shipping and contractual heterogeneity, and prevalent obfuscation/add-on strategies.

원자료 R01565의 적용 맥락: This estimate comes from the 128MB PC100 memory-module category and uses website-day observations for two websites (A and B) in the Pricewatch environment. The data are daily-aggregated sales and average transaction prices from a single multi-site e-retailer covering May 2000–May 2001. The demand regression (Table 3) is estimated by GMM on website-day data and uses log(1+P LowRank) — the site’s rank on Pricewatch for the low-quality offering — controlling for the site’s medium- and high-quality prices and the lowest low-quality price in the market.

원자료 R01566의 적용 맥락: This paper studies online retail markets mediated by the Pricewatch price-search engine, using hourly Pricewatch listings and transaction-level sales and wholesale cost data from a single multi-site retailer for eight product categories (memory modules and AMD Athlon CPUs) between May 2000 and May 2001 (CPUs May–Nov 2000). Units include website-day observations and individual transactions within a US-based computer-parts market characterized by many small e-retailers, rank-ordered price lists, shipping and contractual heterogeneity, and prevalent obfuscation/add-on strategies.
